plan: My value for the prize is $30. To maximize profit, I should bid below my value to ensure I win only if the third-highest bid is significantly lower. Aiming to pay less than my value, I will bid slightly above the midpoint of possible values, which is $24.5, to outbid others without risking overpayment. This strategy balances winning chances and profit maximization.
